## Definition of done

<!-- Tick what applies. Strike through with ~~text~~ and say why if a line genuinely does not. -->

- [ ] Behaviour matches the spec section above
- [ ] Command path, keyboard path, and list-companion path all work
- [ ] Positive and negative tests; a property test where an invariant is introduced or touched
- [ ] All new user-visible strings have i18n keys in every supported locale
- [ ] `axe` clean; focus order verified; state changes announced
- [ ] Error, empty, loading, offline, and conflict states designed and implemented
- [ ] Tooltip added for any new domain concept (definition · what it is not · example)
- [ ] Migration impact assessed; any migration is idempotent and has a re-run test
- [ ] Performance budget checked (map, timeline, dependency graph, or rules)
- [ ] Design tokens used — no raw colours, sizes, or font stacks
- [ ] `docs/plan/backlog.md` status updated for the ticket
